default_ephemeral_runtime.adaptation_reason: Clarify owner-bound user authority updates versus changed immutable loop conditions: an owner-bound child follows its consumer's update contract instead of cancelling and replacing the owner's run. Also documents the script's stop rule (gates 2 and 3, candidate_paths, a directory outside Git); see scripts/until_loop_ephemeral.py. Also documents the lean returns a run with a receipt prints (U21).

Stop rule (owner 2026-10-16, Improve-value study; scope proposed 2026-10-17, awaiting the owner): required_trivial_reviews 2 is the unchanged-content gate instead of two consecutive trivial passes plus an unchanged-first-pass shortcut. It completes on one trivial, satisfied pass whose measured content tree (Git tree plus optional candidate_paths file bytes) equals the previous pass's tree (the first pass: the tree at start); state last_tree replaces start_tree and gate-2 packets report progress.last_pass_changed_tree instead of the streak. Gate 3 (code reviews) is the same measurement with the rule this runtime had before: a first pass that is trivial, satisfied and unchanged completes, and once any pass has changed the tree it takes two such passes in a row; it adds no state field. A directory that is not a Git worktree is measured through a throwaway bare repository, so the gates need no worktree. Gates 0 and 1 and their packet shape are unchanged, so contracts written for the published until-loop plugin stay valid. Version skew (N12): the published plugin 0.8.3 reads 3 as three trivial reviews and refuses candidate_paths, so a contract at gate 3 is for this bundled runtime only; ShipLoop writes it only for an Improve child, which always uses the bundled runtime. Not yet upstreamed to whichguy/until-loop; a re-vendor must carry it. Lean returns (U21, 2026-10-17; rides the same upstream release, D-5): a run started with --receipt prints a lean return from start and done (status, state_file, receipt, a short instruction, conditions.exit, report_fields, next_argv, done_argv, verify_script; PRINTED_KEYS) and keeps the full packet in the receipt; next prints the full packet, and a run without a receipt prints it every time. The Python start and done functions still return the full packet. Measured on a live-shaped ShipLoop step-plan loop at a 163-character run dir: start 11,515 -> 2,733, non-terminal done 22,709 -> 2,778, terminal done 13,447 -> 1,580 characters (test/until-loop-vendor.test.py LeanReturnTests). Not yet upstreamed; a re-vendor must carry it.
